speaker: System

Project:
Offshore Wind Energy in the Conan Sea

speaker: Coordinator
text: You have been invited to support Arcadia's stakeholder consultation on the OWECS project.

speaker: Coordinator
text: This proposal could help transform Arcadia's energy future.

speaker: Coordinator
text: But it may also affect livelihoods, ecosystems, and regional shipping.

speaker: Fisher Representative
text:
You get power.
We lose our fishing grounds.

These wind farms could take away our catch, our livelihood, and the life our communities have built around this sea.

speaker: Environmental Activist
text:
You call it clean energy.
We see fragile ecosystems pushed closer to the edge.

These wind farms could disrupt migratory routes, damage marine habitats, and leave scars that last far beyond construction.

speaker: Shipping Representative
text:
You redraw lines on a map.
We face the delays at sea.

These wind farms could force longer routes, tighter corridors, and rising costs across the region.

speaker: Coordinator
text: Your task is not to defend one side too quickly.

speaker: Coordinator
text: Review the case materials, examine the project area, and consider what a balanced response could look like.
